regulation_clause.text: If a card is unused for more than one year, initiate closure after intimating the cardholder; if no reply within 30 days, close the account (subject to dues) and update the CIC within 30 days.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 20 requires initiating closure after a card is unused for more than one year, with a 30-day cardholder reply window and a 30-day CIC update window. CBTRN02C is the daily transaction-posting batch job; its full validation path (1500-VALIDATE-TRAN calling only 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF and 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT, which check card lookup, credit limit, and expiration only) contains no inactivity, last-activity-date, intimation, or closure-initiation logic anywhere. The paragraph's own comment '* ADD MORE VALIDATIONS HERE' (line 377) marks the natural insertion point for such a check.
